title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Account Limits Quick Reference
content:
**Care desk card — Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership limits**

Applies to every plan: Unlimited Standard Monthly, Unlimited Student Annual, Unlimited Standard Annual, Unlimited Express Monthly, Unlimited Express Annual and Unlimited Next-Day Annual.

| Limit | Value on every plan |
|---|---|
| Card on file needed to join | Yes |
| Benefits shared with other customer profiles | No — the member's own profile only |
| Wait after expiry before rejoining | 0 calendar days |
| Membership fee counts as Marlowe Rewards qualifying spend | No |
| Most Unlimited memberships open at once per customer | 1 |

Notes:

- Unlimited Student Annual additionally requires student status verified by SheerID as enrolled at an accredited US college or university; no other plan has an entry requirement beyond a card on file.
- A rejoining wait of 0 days means a customer whose membership has expired may join again the same day.
- Example (hypothetical): two members of one household each need their own Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership on their own profile, since benefits are not shared across profiles.
